claims.question: q2
claims.claim: Innovative Solutions launched Forward Deployed Services, a service line that embeds Forward Deployed Engineers and architects directly into customer environments to build, manage, and continuously optimize AI and cloud solutions.
claims.quote: today announced the launch of Forward Deployed Services, a new service line that embeds Forward Deployed Engineers (FDE) and architects directly into customer environments to build, manage, and continuously optimize AI and cloud solutions.

claims.question: q2
claims.claim: Innovative Solutions says its new FDE service line applies the same embedded engineering philosophy behind AWS's recent $1 billion investment in its Forward Deployed Engineering organization, which embeds AWS frontier teams inside customer teams and relies on partners to scale the model.
claims.quote: The new service line applies the same embedded engineering philosophy behind AWS’s recent $1 billion investment in its Forward Deployed Engineering organization. The organization embeds AWS frontier teams directly inside customer teams to build and deploy production AI systems. Within this new program, partners play an important role in scaling the model, contributing model expertise, industry knowledge, and complementary skills to ensure the right engineers are available to customers.

claims.question: q6
claims.claim: The Forward Deployed AI Assessment is a fixed-price engagement where an FDE embeds with the customer to evaluate Generative AI readiness, identify high-impact use cases, and build a working proof of concept on customer data; the same engineer builds the POC to avoid handoff translation loss.
claims.quote: A fixed-price engagement where an Innovative Solutions FDE embeds with the customer to evaluate their readiness for Generative AI, identify the highest-impact use cases, and build a working proof of concept on the customer’s data. The same engineer who conducts the assessment builds the proof of concept (POC), eliminating the translation loss that occurs when a consultant hands off to a delivery team.

claims.question: q6
claims.claim: The Forward Deployed POD is a fixed-price engagement where an FDE deploys into the customer environment to deliver one production AI workflow or cloud solution, with an optional Outcome Accelerator success bonus if the defined outcome is achieved.
claims.quote: A fixed-price engagement where a Forward Deployed Engineer deploys into the customer’s environment to deliver a defined outcome, one production AI workflow or cloud solution live in the customer’s environment. An optional Outcome Accelerator adds a success bonus if the defined outcome is achieved, putting Innovative Solutions’ compensation directly in line with customer success.

claims.claim: Forward Deployed Services is a monthly embedded-capacity retainer that keeps an FDE on the customer account long-term, enabled by a managed AI services platform to continuously optimize, monitor, and expand the solutions built.
claims.quote: A monthly embedded-capacity retainer that keeps an FDE on the customer’s account long-term, enabled by Innovative Solutions’ managed AI services platform to continuously optimize, monitor, and expand the solutions they built.
